title: gentiana amarella var. obtusifolia
intro: Gentiana amarella var. obtusifolia, commonly known as American Gentian or Narrow-leaved Gentian, is a perennial plant species belonging to the Gentianaceae family. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, including its ability to act as an expectorant, anti-inflammatory, and antioxidant, making it useful in treating respiratory issues, such as coughs and bronchitis. The therapeutic actions of Gentiana amarella var. obtusifolia include stimulating the secretion of digestive enzymes, improving appetite, and alleviating symptoms of indigestion and stomach discomfort. The bioactive constituents of this plant include gentiopicroside, amarogentin, and gentianine, which are responsible for its medicinal properties and have been studied for their potential in treating various health conditions.
